adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed(embed_url)` returns nil it unconditionally does `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: embed_url)` and renders `loading` (no check for an already-enqueued/pending job). The only request gate shown is `ensure_embeddable`, which relies on `request.referer` host matching `SiteSetting.embeddable_host`—a client-supplied header. Since `embed_url` is also client-controlled and can be varied per request, an attacker who can satisfy/spoof the Referer can trigger many enqueues and downstream fetches (via `TopicRetriever`/`open(url)`), creating a queue-flood/DoS vector.
